WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambient_temp,
    AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_image_count
  FROM scanenvironment AS e
  JOIN sites AS s ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.entrystat
)
SELECT
  entrystat,
  avg_ambient_temp,
  avg_image_count,
  avg_image_count - AVG(avg_image_count) OVER () AS image_avg_minus_status_mean
FROM status_averages;
